blocks.title: Software as a Service (SaaS)
blocks.text: SaaS provides software applications hosted and managed by the provider; users subscribe and use them over the internet, with no hardware to manage and no software updates to install.

Google Workspace (formerly G Suite) includes Gmail, Google Docs and Google Drive; Microsoft Office 365 and Salesforce are other examples. Salesforce is a leading SaaS provider of customer relationship management (CRM) used by over 150,000 companies, and cloud services are priced by usage, pay as you go (Did You Know).
